text.p: Sherwin-Williams Co said on Tuesday it has completed the sale of two adhesives businesses that were part of the recently acquired Pratt & Lambert United Inc.
The cash generated from the pre-divestiture operations and proceeds from the sale of the two businesses was approximately $58.0 million, which will be used to cut short-term debt.
Pierce & Stevens Corp, a manufacturer and retailer of specialty industrial adhesives, was sold to Sovereign Specialty Chemicals Inc.
Miracle Adhesives Corp, a manufacturer and seller of construction adhesives was sold to TACC International Corp.
Combined annual sales of the two businesses totaled approximately $80 million, Sherwin-Williams said.
